title: Allied skiers sabotage the heavy water plant

tellings.quote: >> a team of like Nordic skiers or something to like take out the heavy water plant

plain: During the Second World War, a team of Allied skiers in Norway knocked out a plant making heavy water, a special form of water needed for Nazi Germany's atomic research. Michels mentions it in passing, from memory, in an episode with a writer named Jason Jorjani about a claimed Nazi UFO program. He brings it up as an example of how far the Allies went to stop secret German weapons work.
